name: Aleph
bio: Archetype: Inspiration, Skill Reuse. ⌽ Consumes Eureka when allies act to allow Impromptu attacks to decrease enemy DMG Taken Reduction and Mental DEF. ⌽ Skills give extra AP and consume Eureka to apply team-wide Incantation Might. ⌽ Memorizes a few actively cast normal skills on the turn Ult is used and reuse them next turn. Reused skills retain their Inspiration. ⌽ Has a chance to recover Eureka when spending it. ⌽ Works very well with other Inspiration characters but not so much anywhere else.
